```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: false
source("R/_bootstrap.R")
bootstrap_quarto()
precomputo()  # idempotente: si ya existen los CSVs, no regenera
charcoal_pca      <- read.csv("outputs/charcoal_pca.csv")
charcoal_clusters <- read.csv("outputs/charcoal_clusters.csv")
charcoal_var      <- read.csv("outputs/charcoal_var.csv")
charcoal_rot      <- read.csv("outputs/charcoal_rotation.csv")
charcoal_codo     <- read.csv("outputs/charcoal_codo.csv")
twins_pca         <- read.csv("outputs/twins_pca.csv")
twins_clusters    <- read.csv("outputs/twins_clusters.csv")
twins_var         <- read.csv("outputs/twins_var.csv")
twins_rot         <- read.csv("outputs/twins_rotation.csv")
twins_codo        <- read.csv("outputs/twins_codo.csv")
ojs_define(charcoal_pca, charcoal_clusters, charcoal_var, charcoal_rot, charcoal_codo,
           twins_pca, twins_clusters, twins_var, twins_rot, twins_codo)
```

# Visión general

```{ojs}
// --- Dataset activo (cambia todo lo de abajo) ---
// NOTA: ojs_define() serializa data.frames como object-of-arrays;
// transpose() los convierte a array-of-objects (lo que Plot espera).
viewof dataset = Inputs.select(["charcoal", "twins"], {label: "Dataset"})

pca_all      = transpose(dataset === "charcoal" ? charcoal_pca      : twins_pca)
clusters_all = transpose(dataset === "charcoal" ? charcoal_clusters : twins_clusters)
var_all      = transpose(dataset === "charcoal" ? charcoal_var      : twins_var)
rot_all      = transpose(dataset === "charcoal" ? charcoal_rot      : twins_rot)
codo_all     = transpose(dataset === "charcoal" ? charcoal_codo     : twins_codo)
obs_nombres  = pca_all.map(d => d.obs)
```

```{ojs}
// --- Controles globales (showcase de Inputs) ---
viewof k          = Inputs.range([2, 10], {step: 1, value: 4, label: "k (clústeres)"})
viewof pc_x       = Inputs.select(["PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4"], {value: "PC1", label: "Eje X"})
viewof pc_y       = Inputs.select(["PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4"], {value: "PC2", label: "Eje Y"})
viewof show_label = Inputs.toggle({label: "Etiquetas en biplot", checked: true})
viewof opacity    = Inputs.range([0.2, 1], {step: 0.05, value: 0.7, label: "Opacidad"})
viewof color_by   = Inputs.radio(["cluster", "variable continua"], {label: "Color por", value: "cluster"})
// OJO: Inputs.search(data) NO devuelve el texto buscado, devuelve el
// SUBCONJUNTO FILTRADO de `data` (un Array). Por eso `highlight.trim()` en la
// celda de abajo reventaba con "highlight.trim is not a function".
// Para un string se usa Inputs.text().
viewof highlight  = Inputs.text({label: "Filtrar por nombre", placeholder: "Escribe…"})
viewof bins       = Inputs.range([5, 50], {step: 1, value: 20, label: "Bins histograma"})
// NOTA: Inputs.selection() no existe en @observablehq/inputs 0.10.6 (llegó en 0.10.7).
// Sustituto: Inputs.select({multiple:true}) → devuelve Array (no Set).
viewof pais_sel   = Inputs.select(obs_nombres, {label: "Selección (multi)", multiple: true, size: 7})
viewof accent     = Inputs.color({label: "Color de acento", value: "#0072B2"})
```

```{ojs}
// --- Crossfilter: pais_sel (Array de obs) + highlight (texto) → obs visibles ---
// Convención: si pais_sel está vacío, se muestran todas las observaciones.
obs_visibles = {
  const por_pais = new Set(pais_sel);
  const filtro_activo = pais_sel.length > 0;
  const q = highlight.trim().toLowerCase();
  return obs_nombres.filter(n =>
    (!filtro_activo || por_pais.has(n)) && (q === "" || n.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );
}

pca_filtrada = pca_all.filter(d => obs_visibles.includes(d.obs))
clusters_k   = clusters_all.filter(d => d.k === k && obs_visibles.includes(d.obs))
cluster_de   = new Map(clusters_k.map(d => [d.obs, d.cluster]))
n_visibles   = obs_visibles.length
n_total      = obs_nombres.length
```

## Varianza explicada {scroller-height="280px"}

```{ojs}
md`**Dataset activo:** ${dataset} · **obs visibles:** ${n_visibles}/${n_total} · **var PC1+PC2:** ${(var_all[0].var_pct + var_all[1].var_pct).toFixed(1)}%`
```

```{ojs}
// Scree: barras (var_pct) + línea acumulada (cum_pct)
Plot.plot({
  height: 280,
  x: {label: "Componente"},
  y: {label: "Varianza (%)", domain: [0, 100]},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(var_all, {x: "PC", y: "var_pct", fill: accent, fillOpacity: 0.55}),
    Plot.lineY(var_all, {x: "PC", y: "cum_pct", stroke: "#D55E00", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.text(var_all, {x: "PC", y: "cum_pct", dx: 10, dy: -6,
      text: d => d.cum_pct.toFixed(0) + "%", fill: "#D55E00", fontSize: 9})
  ]
})
```

# PCA

## Biplot `${pc_x}` × `${pc_y}` {height="55%"}

```{ojs}
// Biplot: puntos (obs) + flechas (cargas de rotación)
Plot.plot({
  height: 480,
  x: {label: pc_x, grid: true},
  y: {label: pc_y, grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.arrow(rot_all, {
      x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: d => d[pc_x], y2: d => d[pc_y],
      stroke: "#D55E00", strokeOpacity: 0.65, strokeWidth: 1.5
    }),
    Plot.text(rot_all, {
      x: d => d[pc_x] * 1.12, y: d => d[pc_y] * 1.12,
      text: "variable", fill: "#D55E00", fontSize: 9
    }),
    Plot.dot(pca_filtrada, {
      x: pc_x, y: pc_y,
      fill: color_by === "cluster" ? d => "clúster " + cluster_de.get(d.obs) : accent,
      fillOpacity: opacity, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.5,
      title: d => `${d.obs} · clúster ${cluster_de.get(d.obs) ?? "?"}`
    }),
    ...(show_label
      ? [Plot.text(pca_filtrada, {x: pc_x, y: pc_y, text: "obs",
          fontSize: 8, dx: 4, fill: "grey30"})]
      : [])
  ]
})
```

## Heatmap obs × PC {height="45%"}

```{ojs}
// Heatmap de scores: filtra los PCs visibles al rango dinámico
pca_long = pca_filtrada.flatMap(d =>
  ["PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4"].map(pc => ({obs: d.obs, PC: pc, valor: d[pc]}))
)

Plot.plot({
  height: 360,
  marginTop: 50, marginBottom: 50,
  x: {label: "Componente"},
  y: {label: "Observación", domain: obs_visibles.reverse()},
  color: {scheme: "RdBu", reverse: true, legend: true},
  marks: [Plot.cell(pca_long, {x: "PC", y: "obs", fill: "valor"})]
})
```

# Clústeres

## Curva del codo {height="40%"}

```{ojs}
// tot.withinss vs k (para elegir k)
Plot.plot({
  height: 260,
  x: {label: "k (nº de clústeres)", domain: codo_all.map(d => d.k)},
  y: {label: "tot.withinss"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(codo_all, {x: "k", y: "tot_withinss", stroke: accent, strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(codo_all, {x: "k", y: "tot_withinss", fill: accent, r: 5}),
    Plot.ruleX([k], {stroke: "#D55E00", strokeDasharray: "4 4"})
  ]
})
```

## Histograma de PC1 (bins = `${bins}`) {height="60%"}

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  height: 340,
  x: {label: "PC1"},
  y: {label: "Frecuencia"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(pca_filtrada, Plot.binX({y: "count"}, {x: "PC1", thresholds: bins})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

# Datos

## Tabla cruzada (filtrada por selección y búsqueda)

```{ojs}
// Inputs.table con columnas derivadas (obs + PC1..PC4 + clúster a k actual)
tabla_view = pca_filtrada.map(d => ({
  obs: d.obs,
  PC1: d.PC1.toFixed(3),
  PC2: d.PC2.toFixed(3),
  PC3: d.PC3.toFixed(3),
  PC4: d.PC4.toFixed(3),
  cluster: cluster_de.get(d.obs) ?? "—"
}))

Inputs.table(tabla_view, {
  sort: "obs",
  reverse: false,
  required: false,
  label: `${n_visibles} de ${n_total} observaciones (${dataset}, k=${k})`
})
```

## Filtrado activo

```{ojs}
md`
**Resumen del crossfilter**

- **Dataset:** \`${dataset}\`
- **Selección explícita (pais_sel):** ${pais_sel.length} obs
- **Texto buscado (highlight):** \`${highlight || "—"}\`
- **Obs visibles finales:** **${n_visibles}** / ${n_total}

El crossfilter \`pais_sel\` afecta a la vez al **biplot**, a la **tabla** y al **heatmap**.
Cambia \`viewof dataset\` arriba para saltar entre charcoal y twins: todo se recompute en el navegador, sin backend.
`
```
